body:
Board follow-up to WP10 (core, CLI and server are done by claude-code@sati#75d3e4d7; see decision dec_01M78FHB5W7F66J0F0EKH55SKZ).

1. Decisions cannot be deleted (10.1). The server no longer has DELETE/restore routes for /api/decisions, so the board's Delete button on a decision now gets a 404.
   - Remove the decision Delete and Restore buttons and the undo toast for decisions. `Deletable` in packages/ui/src/api.ts should drop "decision".
   - On the Decisions list, show "Superseded by <title>" on a decision that a newer decision supersedes. Find it from the list: the decision whose `supersedes` is this id.
   - Update the e2e tests that delete a decision in e2e/ui/flows.spec.ts.
2. Milestones can be cancelled (10.2). MILESTONE_STATUSES now has `cancelled`. Transitions: planned to cancelled, active to cancelled, cancelled to planned.
   - On the roadmap timeline, show a cancelled milestone as cancelled, not as open.
   - Add a status option and a label in words.ts (5.4).
   - Anything on the board that treats "not done" as open must skip cancelled.

completion.summary: Board parts of 10.1/10.2: decision Delete button removed, Deletable drops decision, "Superseded by" on replaced decisions, cancelled milestone struck through on the Plan timeline. e2e covers all three.

title: WP10 board parts: decisions without delete, Superseded by, cancelled milestones (review 10.1, 10.2)
